context: Fix the defect OCG-G7's end-to-end proof found: 11 of the 22 Anthropic-capable ids reject tool-bearing requests on /messages, which broke the Claude Code surface for essentially every real turn.
root_causes: The native-path decision consulted the model only, and the endpoint deny-list it consulted was measured with a bare text message.
Endpoint reachability and feature support on that endpoint are different properties, and nothing in the code distinguished them.
evidence: glm-5 on /messages returns 200 without tools and 400 invalid_request_error with tools, while accepting the same tool declaration on /chat/completions.
Scoped across all 22 /messages-capable ids, 11 reject Anthropic-format tools.
Tool support and output_config support are almost perfectly anti-correlated, so neither can be derived from the other.
Before the fix the live proof recorded anthropic_messages glm-5 502; after it, 200 with one parsed get_weather call.
solutions: Add ANTHROPIC_TOOL_UNSUPPORTED_MODELS as a second, independent gate rather than a refinement of the endpoint deny-list.
Consult it only when the payload actually declares tools, treating an empty list as not tool bearing.
Route tool-bearing requests for those ids over the existing chat-completions fallback, which already worked for grok-4.5.
Gate the tool deny-list against the recorded proof artifact so code and evidence cannot diverge.
acceptance_criteria: A tool-bearing Anthropic request for a tools-rejecting id routes over chat-completions and completes.
A tool-bearing request for a tools-supporting id still takes the native path.
A tool-free request is unaffected for both groups.
An empty tools list does not abandon the native path.
The streaming path is tool aware too.
The endpoint deny-list still wins over the tool gate.
The tool deny-list matches the recorded proof, asserted by test.
Tool support is asserted independent of endpoint support.
legacy_risk_reason: changes which upstream transport carries every tool-bearing Anthropic request for this backend; a regression silently reroutes Claude Code traffic or reintroduces a 400 on every real turn
